causal_decision_rules.behavioral_admission: report intent-to-treat and preregistered clean-exact/failure-present strata; never replace a failed prompt, seed, or lexicalization
causal_decision_rules.clean_restoration: same-activation no-op and post-hook stock rerun must match stock saved pixels, trajectory tensors, RNG state, and hook inventory exactly
causal_decision_rules.hard_failure_explained: candidate must causally account for controlled coloured-shape exact-count errors; no relational-binding, style, general concept, or architectural incapability claim is permitted

specificity.energy_match: actual post-runtime-dtype Frobenius delta within 1 percent

heldout_alignment_failure_decodability.descriptive_measure: exact requested-count readout accuracy among objective count failures, tested one-sided above fixed six-class chance 1/6
heldout_alignment_failure_decodability.interpretation_boundary: positive failure decodability supports downstream realization loss; it is not causal evidence and cannot establish architectural incapacity

observational_anatomy_token_mean_region_.description: joint.4 is descriptively stronger than final merged single.19 and prediction at every captured call; joint.4 call 1 is the peak all-region cell

discovery_descriptive_context.paired_factor_boundary: color and shape are paired in the panel; no independent color-versus-shape causal claim is permitted

posthoc_output_alignment.permitted_interpretation: high requested count remains observationally decodable on many output failures, motivating a preregistered downstream-realization endpoint

guarded_beast_contract.batch_parity_policy: same-prompt homogeneous-arm B2/B4 exact trajectory and pixel parity; immediate B1 fallback; mixed-arm or mixed-prompt packing forbidden
